The plate is square, about 350 px across in the image. If it is a side plate of about 22 cm, that gives roughly 16 px per cm.

The carrots cover about 220 x 240 px, but they fill only part of that area, perhaps 40%. That is about 21,000 px², or roughly 80 cm². They are sliced diagonally and about 1.5 cm thick, so the volume is about 80 × 1.3 ≈ 105 cm³. Allowing for gaps and overlap, I estimate about 100 g.

There are around 14 pieces, each about 7 g, which also comes to about 100 g.

The carrots look glazed or roasted, so I'll use 50 kcal per 100 g for the carrots. I can't see any separate sauce or oil, so I'm not listing any.
